{{Citation}}
[[File:GovernorVizsla-SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], governor of [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]], a moon of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]]]
{{Quote|The regional governors now have direct control over their territories.|[[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], announcing the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution of the Imperial Senate]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
A '''governor''' was the head of government for a colony, province, or other sub-national body politic in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. There were several usages of the word throughout the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

==Old Republic governors==
Governors existed in the Galactic Republic, though it was a federal system, therefore control of local systems and sectors were left to their own governments. It seems that the Old Republic only used governors temporarily, for systems that were unstable or for those that were newly-admitted to the Republic and lacked any capable governing system of their own. [[Mousul]] sought to get appointed sector governor of [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion's]] region of space.

During the Jedi Civil War [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] had a [[Sith Governor|Governor]] appointed to oversee the Sith on Taris. He was eventually killed by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who was seeking passage off-world.

The one known example of an Old Republic governor was in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]], which was ruled by a governor and a '''[[Lieutenant governor/Legends|lieutenant governor]]''' from at least [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] until the end of the Republic. The governor and lieutenant governor of the sector also simultaneously served as the governor/lieutenant governor of its capital planet, [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].

==Imperial Governors==
[[File:Imperial_Governor.jpg|thumb|left|180px|An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] governor]]
The Empire left the self-government of many planets intact, especially those that were either indifferent or supportive of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] (such as [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]). Less than 1/80th of all planets had their governments altered. Planets that rebelled, were deemed hostile to the New Order, or newly-annexed by the Empire, had governors appointed. Certain worlds that had [[Senator/Legends|senators]] who were deemed less than loyal to the Emperor were sometimes assigned governors, despite the opposition of their senator. This was the case on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], when [[Jesco Comark]] was appointed as Imperial Governor to keep watch on Senator [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]. However, pressure by the populace, who were loyal to the more experienced Mothma, caused Comark to abandon the post.<ref name="DH">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>

Other worlds, which were further away from Coruscant, such as [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], retained their government with only minor changes, but also had an appointed governor. The Empire also kept the position of '''Lieutenant Governor'''. Except for a few governors chosen by Palpatine, Imperial Governors were selected by the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] and received most orders from the [[Diplomatic Services]]. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had vague plans for eventually replacing the planetary governors with [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]], creating a "Dark Empire".

For Imperial governors of [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] and [[Oversector/Legends|oversectors]], see '''[[Moff/Legends|Moff]]'''.

==New Republic governors==
The New Republic's policy on governors (termed '''Governors-General''') seemed to mirror that of the Old Republic. Both [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]] had Governors-General, and at least Corellia's was elected by the planet's population. The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] continued the system, although several years after the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] it removed the Governor-General system from Corellia.
